question: Quantify fragmentation for investment memo
limitations: Broad market includes private-party transactions; it is not dealer-only sales or wholesale transactions.
CarMax fiscal year ends February 2026 versus calendar2025 denominator; derived share is approximate scale comparison.
NADA count is franchised locations, not independent used-only dealers or distinct corporate owners; owner share is not sales share.
Top-five U.S. concentration not established. Rankings can exclude used-only specialists and consolidated company units can include non-U.S. activity.
CarMax is omnichannel, not pure e-commerce; other chains also offer digital channels. Fragmentation does not prove profitable share capture.
